title: QUIZ - 38
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Combining Two Like Terms
questions.learningObjective: Combine two like terms with the same variable by adding or subtracting coefficients
questions.question: Simplify: \( 8t - 2t \)
questions.explanation: Since both terms contain t, subtract their coefficients: 8 - 2 = 6, giving 6t.
questions.hint: Combine like terms by adding or subtracting their coefficients, keeping the variable part unchanged.

questions.concept: Combining Like Terms in Multi-Term Expressions
questions.learningObjective: Simplify an expression with multiple variables by combining only the like terms
questions.question: Simplify: \( 3t + 4y - 3t + 11 \)
questions.explanation: Combine the t terms: 3t - 3t = 0t. The y term and constant have no like terms, so the result is \( 4y + 11 \).
questions.hint: Only combine terms that share the exact same variable; leave other terms unchanged.

questions.concept: Combining Like Terms in Multi-Term Expressions
questions.learningObjective: Simplify an expression with multiple variables by combining only the like terms
questions.question: Simplify: \( 3a + 6x - 1a + 10 \)
questions.explanation: Combine the a terms: 3a - 1a = 2a. The x term and constant have no like terms, so the result is \( 2a + 6x + 10 \).
questions.hint: Only combine terms that share the exact same variable; leave other terms unchanged.

questions.concept: Combining Like Terms in Multi-Term Expressions
questions.learningObjective: Simplify an expression with multiple variables by combining only the like terms
questions.question: Simplify: \( 6n + 2t - 8n + 7 \)
questions.explanation: Combine the n terms: 6n - 8n = -2n. The t term and constant have no like terms, so the result is \( -2n + 2t + 7 \).
questions.hint: Only combine terms that share the exact same variable; leave other terms unchanged.
